pages.text: Altered from $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(4)Atheism$() increases resistance against magical attacks. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Corporeality$(), $(4)Algid Resistor$() and $(4)Vigor$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: If your worst enemies are damaging potion effects or magic wielders, the Atheism Execration is your best friend. It can be especially effective against poisons.
